subject: 15m preflight: brief stack + latency check before full demo
messages:
From: Jordan Kemp <jkemp@brightstore.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 15m stack/latency check before demo

Hi Soojin—

Thanks for the quick platform — I signed up via the self-serve flow yesterday and started poking around. Before we commit to a full demo for our engineering team we'd appreciate a short 15-minute technical triage to confirm a few constraints: 
- VPC peering / private endpoint options for production traffic
- Data residency (we have separate US and EU clusters; want to ensure EU-only storage/processing is possible)
- Typical p95 token latency for 8k-context models and expectations with small batching

I've attached a high-level architecture diagram and a short network requirements doc for context. I can do Wed–Fri after 2pm PDT (UTC-7) this week — any 15-minute slot that works for your engineering SDR is fine.

Attachments: arch-diagram.png (image/png), network-requirements.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Jordan Kemp
Head of Platform, BrightStore
jkemp@brightstore.com
(415) 555-0142
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Kemp <jkemp@brightstore.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 15m stack/latency check before demo

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the context and for attaching the diagram — very helpful. Glad you were able to self-serve and get a feel for the platform.

I can do a short 15-minute triage to run through VPC options and latency expectations. Quick questions so our call is focused:
- Is your BrightStore test environment currently in AWS eu-west-1 or us-west-2?
- Do you need HSM/KMS integration during the triage or just confirmation of the pattern?
- Any strict max acceptable p95 latency for inference (token-level) that we should aim to validate?

If you confirm those, I can loop Ben (our SDR) to propose two concrete 15-minute windows and send a calendar invite.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Kemp <jkemp@brightstore.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 15m stack/latency check before demo — quick options

Hey Jordan — looping in to book the slot. Thanks for the diagram — that helps. Based on Soojin's availability, here are two 15-minute windows (all PDT / UTC-7):
- Thursday 2027-04-29 14:30–14:45
- Friday 2027-04-30 15:00–15:15

If neither works, tell us two times that do and we'll move things around. We'll use the first 5 minutes to confirm network/peering and the remaining 10 to run a simple inference to observe p95 behavior with 8k context.

Proposed attendees: Soojin (solutions), Ben (SDR), Jordan (platform lead), plus an engineer from BrightStore if possible.

Calendar invite will follow once you confirm.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Kemp <jkemp@brightstore.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 15m stack/latency check before demo — quick options

Thanks Ben — appreciate the options. Both of the proposed slots overlap with our sprint planning. Can we move to Monday 2027-05-03 09:30–09:45 PDT instead? Same agenda: quick peering check + a short p95 run if time allows.

One more note: our infra team prefers if we don't do any production credentials exchange on that call — a read-only connectivity check and latency run from a test instance is fine.

If that works I'll forward the internal engineer and confirm the attendee name.

Jordan
Jordan Kemp
Head of Platform, BrightStore
jkemp@brightstore.com
